title: CrossScopeAuthorityGrant
description: PACK-09, ADR-041. Owned by compliance-service (epd2_compliance_service.domain.CrossScopeAuthorityGrant). The ONLY way any organizational boundary is crossed in PACK-09. There is no hierarchy-derived inheritance: a Bund-level organization holds nothing over a Landesverband's cases unless that Landesverband issued a grant, and a Kreisverband holds nothing over its parent Land's either (PACK-09 required invariant 2). The grant must also be PRESENTED by the caller for the specific operation - merely existing in the store is not enough. capabilities is a closed, enumerated list with no wildcard and no 'all' value. No field here carries an identity attribute, a global person identifier, a document or its bytes, an authentication secret, or any ballot/vote/tally/delegation reference (PACK-09 required invariants 1, 11, 12 and 13). Natural persons appear only as per-case party references minted by epd2_compliance_service.domain.mint_case_party_reference, which resolve to nothing inside or outside this service.
